implementation_flow: service() may still synchronize runtime/session/registration after any provider result, including a failure.

syncRuntime() updates those runtime projections but replaces journey.profile only when there is no active profileId or the route profileId exactly matches raw ownProfile.profile.id; it does not compare against teacherId.

A successful create always stores its local display overlay for future own-profile reads, then updates the visible profile/draft/source only on the generic own-profile route or exact own public alias when the current projection is present and has the created profile ID.
Foreign, captured read-only, pending, not-found, and error public-profile projections remain owned by their route; the current projection is never dereferenced when null.

tdd.red_result: 0 passed, 4 failed; each failed at the expected route/projection equality because the original source replaced the current public projection with the signed-in teacher's own profile.

regressions.create_over_foreign_profile: A held TeacherProfile.createProfile completes while /public-profile/demo-avery is active. The route continues displaying demo-avery / demo-seed-avery; edit is denied with profile_owner_mismatch. Navigating afterward to the new own public alias displays the local overlay and edit succeeds.
regressions.create_over_captured_reference: A held create completes while /public-profile/reference-sarah is active. The exact captured-readonly projection remains unchanged; edit is denied with read_only_reference.
regressions.create_during_public_read: A held create resolves while TeacherProfile.openPublicProfile for demo-jordan is pending. The loading/null projection remains unchanged without a null dereference; releasing the read then displays demo-jordan / demo-seed-jordan.
regressions.failed_create_with_existing_own_profile: A duplicate create returns profile_exists while the captured Sarah reference is active. Generic service() synchronization does not replace the captured projection on failure.
